title: God of War Costs You 97¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
God of War is $19.99 on Steam this week (60% off until 1 Dec) and takes about 20.6 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat, main story): 97¢ an hour. At the full $49.99 it's $2.43 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 25 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend who still hasn't played God of War: 97¢ an hour this week, $2.43 at full price.
